source: 敵の小型戦艦 20 種類の追加用 90 枚 (シート 84〜93、ユーザーが別に生成した画像)。機関と推進
style: Small hostile warships of the "Void fleet" in a stylised sci-fi space game: dark gunmetal, angular, worn, with glowing accent lights. PICTURE cells: ONE item or scene seen exactly straight on (or from directly above), filling the cell, flat even light, no readable text, letters, numbers or real-world logos. CUTOUT-style PICTURE cells say "on plain pure white background": draw only the object or emblem, centred, on flat pure white with no shadow. Tiles are flat, evenly lit and seamless.
